description: This file defines the SqlsrvManager class in PHP, which extends the MssqlManager class to provide database management functionalities specific to SQL Server via the sqlsrv extension. It includes methods for connecting, querying, error handling, schema inspection, and other database operations tailored for SQL Server.

classes.name: SqlsrvManager
classes.description: A manager class for SQL Server databases using the sqlsrv extension, providing methods for connection, query execution, schema management, and error handling specialized for SQL Server.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SQL Server database using provided configuration options.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query or array of queries, handling logging and error checking.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of field names from a query result, optionally converting to lowercase.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the query result as an associative array, processing varchar fields for empty space issues.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a string value to its SQL Server representation based on data type, overriding parent method for datetime.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two variable definitions for schema compatibility, handling 'id' types specifically.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and performs cleanup.

methods.name: freeDbResult
methods.description: Frees the database result resource.

methods.name: getConstraintSql
methods.description: Generates SQL for table constraints, ensuring clustered index existence.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a table, including data types, nullability, defaults, and identity info.

methods.name: doesTableHaveAClusteredIndexDefined
methods.description: Checks if the specified table has a clustered index defined.

methods.name: doesTableHaveAFulltextIndexDefined
methods.description: Checks if the table has a fulltext index.

methods.name: changeColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to change a column, with special handling for fulltext indexes.

methods.name: truncateTableSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statement for truncating a table.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Retrieves the last database error messages, filtering out non-critical messages.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the database server and client.

methods.name: verifyGenericQueryRollback
methods.description: Runs a data manipulation query inside a transaction and rolls it back, used for testing.

methods.name: verifyInsertInto
methods.description: Tests insert queries by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: verifyUpdate
methods.description: Tests update queries by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: verifyDeleteFrom
methods.description: Tests delete queries by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: selectDb
methods.description: Switches the database context.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the sqlsrv extension is available for this driver.
